cases.factSheet: Contract 0xa7046Fc653556b8d50370Ab8dB189b2E447eacDb (Sourcify exact match). The mint price reads 0 BNB, but every mint also pays a creator fee of 0.000075 BNB straight to the creator wallet. Supply: 479 of 6,666 minted.

cases.factSheet: Mint contract 0x6288DFe86f22B53eEB6886aE2D78941de7483743. The 'free' Mode A requires a deposit of 0.002 BNB per share, locked in the contract for 24 hours and refunded afterwards together with AGC tokens. At check time refund obligations were 44.668 BNB and the contract balance was 44.668 BNB (fully covered).
cases.groundTruth: Requires a 0.002 BNB per-share deposit locked 24h — capital up front, not free.
cases.name: Agentic Coin (AGC)

cases.factSheet: Contract 0x587C303982187Ec578dF309d27670327b13202F8 (Sourcify exact match). totalMinted is 3,333 of the 3,333 maximum — the free window is exhausted, although the contract's mintOpen flag still reads open.

cases.name: Paw Gang

cases.claimText: First 777 mints free for Agent ID holders, 1 per wallet

cases.groundTruth: Free pool exhausted (freeRemaining 0); page still advertises free; only a 0.0006 BNB paid lane remains.
cases.name: JINCHAN

cases.groundTruth: Sold out 15,555/15,555 (amended case — see designNote). Excluded from the cost-error metric per the original design.

cases.name: Shenlong

cases.claimText: First koi free for Agent ID holders, 1 per wallet — feed it daily and it grows
cases.factSheet: Contract 0xbd4b4e7189ae9356514664146b0ed683601200a9 (Sourcify exact match). freeMinted is 2,665 of the 2,777 free pool — free mints remain, and a value-0 freeMint() passes from an Agent ID wallet (1 per wallet).
cases.groundTruth: Genuinely free while the pool lasts (second control case); 112 free left at freeze — draining, flagged per design §9.
cases.name: Ink Koi

designNote: Case set per study-design-draft.md §2, with ONE pre-run amendment, documented before any model run: Pokechain's correct decision is amended from ABSTAIN to SKIP. Reason: since the design draft was written, the radar located the contract (via the marketplace docs tab) and verified on two RPCs that supply is exhausted (15,555/15,555), so the ground truth is now nailed down and 'not free / nothing to mint' is the correct call. Abstention on Pokechain is still recorded and reported separately as a cautious-abstention measure. Ink Koi added as a second MINT control (design §2 allows up to 4 extra frozen cases); its free pool was draining at freeze (112 left), so per §9 the case is flagged if a later radar check shows the pool empty before the runs complete.
